title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin holds at $63,049 after a 1.6% gain even as Fear & Greed sits at 22 in extreme fear. The network shows strength with hashrate at 897.8 EH/s and a quiet mempool of 92,735 transactions where the fastest fee is just 2 sat/vB. Block 957,335 confirms steady production. Volume and market cap data remain unavailable. No major headlines broke during the US session. The move higher against depressed sentiment points to accumulation rather than broad conviction.
